args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Diagnosed the issue**
   - `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18.
   - Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and was **unhealthy**, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was **healthy** in production.

2. **Rolled back in all regions**
   - Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** across all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**
   - Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback performed.

4. **Verified recovery**
   - Post-rollback status confirms `checkout-api` is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the problematic release — the incident is open so the on-call engineer can investigate the root cause before any re-deploy attempt.
